facts.fact: NASA Harvest says the machine-learning and remote-sensing GEOCIF yield forecast model, downscaled to Admin-2 level in Malawi, supplies maize yield forecasts that the Ministry of Agriculture uses operationally to support its regular crop estimates.
NASA Harvest says GEOCIF maize yield forecast estimates are provided to Malawi's Ministry of Agriculture monthly, during the 2022/2023 season and the 2023/2024 season.

facts.fact: NASA Harvest says satellite-based tools and high-resolution cropland masks built for Namibia, provided to the Ministry of Agriculture, Water and Land Reform under a USAID-funded FAO pilot, were used operationally in 2023 and continue to support regular crop monitoring.

facts.fact: NASA Harvest says the machine-learning GEOCIF model provides the Malawi Ministry of Agriculture with monthly maize yield forecasts that support its regular crop estimates.

NASA Harvest says its AI and machine-learning team built a high-resolution national cropland mask for Namibia, provided to the Ministry of Agriculture, Water and Land Reform under a pilot to better target monitoring and assessments.

MWI.note: The models were built by NASA Harvest; no build in Malawi is stated.
